_metadata.description: The Logo page: a repo-owned operator surface for candidates, compare, actions, refine and target preview.

requirements.title: Candidate gallery with lineage
requirements.description: The /logo route shows a brand selector and a paginated gallery of candidate cards (thumbnail, concept, origin badge, status chip, prompt excerpt, created time) grouped by concept with lineage links.

validation.notes: Built: /logo route, candidate gallery grouped by concept with lineage badges (src/features/logo/LogoCandidateGallery.tsx + LogoCandidateGallery.test.tsx); compare strip with 64/32/16 size strip (LogoCompare.tsx); refine panel for instruction, vectorize, background removal and a brush mask (LogoRefinePanel.tsx, MaskBrush.tsx); target preview sheet at 16/32/64/180/512 on light and dark grounds with the maskable circle (LogoTargetPreview.tsx + test). Live screenshots at evidence/final/logo-page-1280.png and logo-page-400.png.

requirements.title: Compare and actions
requirements.description: An operator can select two to four candidates for side-by-side compare with a 64/32/16 px size strip, and can pick, reject and restore.

validation.notes: Built: /logo route, candidate gallery grouped by concept with lineage badges (src/features/logo/LogoCandidateGallery.tsx + LogoCandidateGallery.test.tsx); compare strip with 64/32/16 size strip (LogoCompare.tsx); refine panel for instruction, vectorize, background removal and a brush mask (LogoRefinePanel.tsx, MaskBrush.tsx); target preview sheet at 16/32/64/180/512 on light and dark grounds with the maskable circle (LogoTargetPreview.tsx + test). requirements.title: Refine by instruction or brush mask
requirements.description: Refine is available through a text field and a canvas brush that exports a PNG mask and calls RefineCandidate with the mask asset; a vectorize action is also available.

requirements.title: Target preview sheet
requirements.description: The preview sheet renders every declared target size at 16/32/64/180/512 px on light and dark grounds, with the maskable circle overlay and the og card at reduced scale.
